name: customer-signal-router
description: Drains a queue of customer signals (support messages, in-app feedback, reviews) and routes each by what it needs. judge-triage separates real issues from chatter/dupes/vague, then judge-severity tiers the real ones to the right responder. Questions get answered, duplicates linked, noise auto-acknowledged. A queue-driven front door that keeps humans focused on what matters.

phases.name: classify-signal
phases.description: Is this an actionable issue, a duplicate, noise, or too-vague?

actionable.name: tier-by-severity
actionable.description: Route the real issue to the right responder by severity.

critical.name: page-lead-critical
critical.description: Critical customer impact — escalate to the support lead immediately.

high.name: lead-high
high.description: High impact — the support lead owns the response.

medium.name: agent-medium
medium.description: Normal issue — a support agent handles it.

duplicate.name: link-known
duplicate.description: Link to the known issue and acknowledge.

noise.name: auto-acknowledge
noise.description: Chatter / praise / off-topic — send a friendly acknowledgement, no ticket.

needs-info.name: request-detail
needs-info.description: Too vague to act on — ask the customer for specifics.
